_fillers: A turn made only of these is treated as noise (speech detected, nothing usable).
_textbook_markers: Formal phrases typical of a read-out textbook answer (used to spot copied explanations).

own_words.hi: Achha bola! Ab apne words mein batao, kyun?
own_words.en: Nicely said! Now tell me in your own words: why?
own_words.dev: अच्छा बोला! अब अपने वर्ड्स में बताओ, क्यों?

noise.hi: Bahut shor hai, thoda paas aakar bolo na?
noise.en: It's very noisy. Can you come closer and say it again?
noise.dev: बहुत शोर है, थोड़ा पास आकर बोलो ना?

explain_nudge.hi: Jo bhi pata hai, woh batao! Thoda sa bhi chalega.
explain_nudge.en: Tell me whatever you know! Even a little bit is fine.
explain_nudge.dev: जो भी पता है, वो बताओ! थोड़ा सा भी चलेगा.

done.hi: Wah, maza aa gaya! Ruko, sochne do...
done.en: That was fun! Wait, let me think...
done.dev: वाह, मज़ा आ गया! रुको, सोचने दो.

strength_reasoning.hi: Tumne apne reasons achhe se diye.
strength_reasoning.en: You gave good reasons for your answers.
strength_reasoning.dev: तुमने अपने रीज़न्स अच्छे से दिए.

strength_none.hi: Tumne himmat se samjhane ki koshish ki.
strength_none.dev: तुमने हिम्मत से समझाने की कोशिश की.

missing.hi: Agli baar {x} ke baare mein bhi sochna.
missing.dev: अगली बार {x} के बारे में भी सोचना.

all_good.hi: Tumne saari main baatein cover kar li!
all_good.en: You covered all the main ideas!
all_good.dev: तुमने सारी मेन बातें कवर कर लीं!

high.hi: Tum toh teacher ban sakte ho, shabaash!
high.en: You could be a teacher, well done!
high.dev: तुम तो टीचर बन सकते हो, शाबाश!

mid.hi: Bahut badhiya! Ek baar aur samjhao, aur pakka ho jayega.
mid.en: Great job! Explain once more and it will stick.
mid.dev: बहुत बढ़िया! एक बार और समझाओ, और पक्का हो जाएगा.

low.hi: Koi baat nahi, seekhna aise hi hota hai. Phir se try karein?
low.en: That's okay, this is how learning works. Shall we try again?
low.dev: कोई बात नहीं, सीखना ऐसे ही होता है. फिर से ट्राई करें?
